title_en: Seven steps, no secrets: steps 1 to 3
title_ar: سبع خطوات بلا أسرار: الخطوات من الأولى إلى الثالثة
objective: Open the year with a plain-language look at the first three steps of the line, so followers want the rest of the series.
hero_en: The Sudair City campus at golden hour seen from the air, with three tall petal-shaped glowing windows in a fan above it, each window holding one early step: a gloved hand over a row of flasks, a clean-room corridor, a store of incoming materials. Dark emerald on the left for the headline. No people, no readable labels.
generated_elements: Petal-window composite in the KV1 style: windows filled with crops of A009 and A003 plus one generated store-of-materials scene with no readable labels or brands; logo placed in the layout tool.
compliance_note: FLAG: describes manufacturing steps 1 to 3 in plain words; no efficacy, safety, statistic, comparison, product or vendor named; no readable label in any image.
sub_en: Steps 1 to 3 of how a medicine is made at Sudair City.
caption_ar:
للخط الذي نعمل عليه سبع خطوات، من وصول المواد إلى خروج الدفعة.
نبدأ هذا الأسبوع بالثلاث الأولى: الاستلام، والوزن، والتحضير.
تابعونا لتعرفوا بقية الخطوات.
caption_en:
The line we work on has seven steps, from materials arriving to the batch leaving.
This week we start with the first three: receive, weigh, prepare.
Follow along for the rest.
claim_detail: Client must confirm that the line can be described as seven steps and that steps 1 to 3 (materials arrive and are logged, each ingredient is weighed, ingredients are combined in a clean room) match the real sequence at the Sudair City plant.

slides.hero_en: The campus seen from the air at golden hour under three glowing petal windows; headline on the dark emerald left side. No people.
Seven small rounded step cards joined by a thin mint line on emerald, numbers in circles and one-word labels; steps 1 to 3 lit in mint, 4 to 7 dimmed. No photograph needed.
slides.body_ar: استلام، وزن، تحضير، تعبئة، تغليف، إفراج، شحن.
slides.body_en: Receive. Weigh. Prepare. Fill. Pack. Release. Ship.

slides.hero_en: Step card 1 with a generated store of incoming materials on pallets and shelves, soft light, no readable labels, no brand marks.
slides.body_ar: تصل المواد إلى المصنع وتُسجَّل قبل أي عمل.
slides.body_en: Materials arrive at the plant and are logged before any work begins.

slides.hero_en: Step card 2 with a close crop of a gloved hand beside a row of glass flasks on a bench, no label legible.
slides.body_ar: يُوزن كل مكوّن ويُقاس بحسب ما تحتاجه الدفعة.
slides.body_en: Each ingredient is weighed and measured out for the batch.

slides.hero_en: Step card 3 with the clean-room corridor in cool light, empty, long perspective, no signage readable.
slides.body_ar: تُجمع المكوّنات المقاسة داخل غرفة نظيفة.
slides.body_en: The measured ingredients are brought together inside a clean room.

slides.hero_en: Typography only on deep emerald with a thin mint rule, one small palm line icon in white, hairline inset frame; no photograph. Logo placed in the layout tool.
slides.body_ar: الخطوات من الرابعة إلى السادسة تصلكم الأسبوع القادم.
